company.name: Knowde
company.shortDescription: The leading software platform for the chemical industry.
company.description:
We are the node that connects knowledge.

Knowde is the leading software platform for the chemical industry. Built on the world's largest, purpose-built chemical taxonomy, Knowde’s software powers digital transformation for global chemical producers and distributors to unlock new possibilities in chemical operations. The company is backed by notable investors including Sequoia Capital, Coatue, and sixteen other venture funds. Learn more at knowde.com.

productsAndServices.description: A data processing system that extracts, structures, harmonizes, and enriches chemical industry data from various sources to create a clean, unified data set.
productsAndServices.name: Knowde AI

productsAndServices.description: A centralized master data management platform that stores and manages clean, structured chemical industry data for use across enterprise systems.
productsAndServices.name: Knowde MDM Platform

productsAndServices.description: A customer experience platform integrated with master data management, enabling chemical companies to deploy complex digital storefronts on their websites.
productsAndServices.name: Knowde CXP

productsAndServices.description: An online marketplace platform where chemical companies can create storefronts to digitally trade and expand their reach within the industry.
productsAndServices.name: Knowde Marketplace

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $60,000,000, or 26.93% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,033,271 to $757,254,351, a 125.51x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 66 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include ThomasNet, ThoughtSpot, Treasure Data.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
